key_evidence_spans: A man in his early 70s presented with a 2-year history of a mildly pruritic, erythematous, and gradually enlarging lesion
Physical examination revealed an ill-defined, nonindurated, erythematous-violaceous plaque
Band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis with no grenz zone
Round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells
Immunohistochemistry: Vascular channel endothelial cells were positive for CD34 and CD31
No hemosiderin deposits found with Perls Prussian blue stain
The patient had applied topical corticosteroids and antifungals with no improvement
